comment: Pinned inputs for a reproducible Synthea run. Changing anything here changes the cohort.

selection.rule: alive AND >=1 inpatient Encounter (class IMP) with period.end AND >=1 active Condition AND >=1 active MedicationRequest
selection.order: most recent inpatient discharge first, then Synthea UUID

import.comment: Claims, EOBs, labs, procedures, imaging, documents and provenance are not imported. Entries are converted from POST to PUT with id = Synthea UUID so imports are idempotent and Patient ids are stable.
